title: Deep Dark 220 C
body_html: The coolest, deepest shade in the family — Deep Dark 220 C leans rosy-mahogany for the richest skin tones that need a true cool match. It melts in fast, covers shadow and blemishes without turning ashy or orange, and holds its tone from sunrise to last call. Cool and unbothered.

title: Deep Dark 210 N
body_html: Deep Dark 210 N sits deep and neutral, with a slightly cooler cast that keeps it from tipping orange on the richest skin tones. It melts on contact, blurs dark spots and shadow, and wears comfortably without creasing into laugh lines. Deep coverage that still feels weightless.

title: Deep Dark 205 N
body_html: A shade richer than Deep Dark 200 N, Deep Dark 205 N keeps the same neutral balance with more depth behind it. It presses into skin smooth, covering shadow and blemishes without ever looking cakey or gray, and stays put through the longest of days. Blend it out and go.

title: Deep Dark 200 N
body_html: Deep Dark 200 N holds true neutral for the deepest skin tones, no warm or cool lean to fight. It melts in fast, blurs blemishes and undereye shadow, and sets into a natural finish that holds its tone from morning to night without going patchy. Reliable, every time.

title: Deep Dark 190 W
body_html: Deep Dark 190 W runs warm and rich, built for the deepest skin tones with a golden undertone that needs real depth to match. It blends seamlessly, covering shadow and blemishes with a buttery finish that never looks ashy or flat. Full coverage, zero flashback, all day long.

title: Dark 180 N
body_html: Dark 180 N is the deepest neutral before the range goes deep-dark, built for skin that doesn't lean warm or cool. It melts in on contact, covers blemishes and shadow evenly, and wears comfortably without creasing into fine lines by evening. Simple, steady, dependable coverage.

title: Dark 175 N
body_html: A shade richer than Dark 170 N, Dark 175 N holds the same neutral balance for deep skin that needs a bit more depth. It taps on smooth, buffs out redness and shadow, and sets into a natural finish that skips the mask-like look completely. Blend and be done.

title: Dark 170 N
body_html: Dark 170 N sits at true neutral for deep skin — no warm push, no cool pull, just the right match. It melts in fast, blurs blemishes and undereye shadow, and stays put through a long day without settling into creases. Easy shade, easier wear.

title: Dark 158 W
body_html: Amber and warm, Dark 158 W is made for deep skin with a golden undertone that needs more than a basic match. It blends like second skin, covering shadow and redness without turning gray or chalky. Build it up for full glam or keep it sheer for everyday.

title: Dark 153 C
body_html: Dark 153 C keeps a cool, rosy cast for deep skin that doesn't want to look orange by midday. It melts on contact, blurs dark circles and blemishes, and holds its true tone from your morning coffee to your last Zoom call. Cool girls, this one's yours.

title: Medium Dark 145 W
body_html: Toasty and rich, Medium Dark 145 W is built for deeper medium skin with warmth to spare. It presses into skin fast, covering shadow and blemishes with a buttery finish that never looks flat or powdery. Build it up for full coverage days or keep it light — your call.

title: Medium Dark 125 N
body_html: Medium Dark 125 N splits the difference — not warm, not cool, just right for medium-deep skin. It blends in seconds, blurs blemishes and dark circles, and wears through a full shift without creasing into fine lines. Low effort, high payoff, exactly what a good neutral should be.

title: Medium Dark 120 W
body_html: A step deeper than Medium Dark 115 W, Medium Dark 120 W keeps the same golden warmth with more richness behind it. The formula melts on contact, building from sheer to full coverage without ever looking dry or gray under lights. It's the shade that just gets skin right.

title: Medium Dark 115 W
body_html: Caramel-warm and built for it — Medium Dark 115 W covers medium-deep skin with a golden undertone that cooler shades just can't match. It taps on smooth, blurs blemishes and shadow, and settles into a natural finish that photographs like skin, not spackle. Long day, zero touch-ups.

title: Medium Dark 113 C
body_html: Medium Dark 113 C keeps things cool for richer medium-deep skin, no warm creep allowed. It melts in fast, covers dark spots and undereye shadow, and stays true to tone instead of oxidizing orange by 2pm. Buildable, blendable, and built to hold through a full workday.

title: Medium 105 N
body_html: Medium 105 N holds steady at neutral for medium-deep skin that doesn't need a warm or cool nudge. It melts fast, blurs blemishes and shadow without shifting shades on skin, and sets into a natural finish that skips the cakey look entirely. Reliable, easy, done in seconds.

title: Medium 100 W
body_html: A touch deeper than Medium 90 W, still all honey warmth. Medium 100 W covers dark circles and redness with a buttery texture that presses in rather than sitting on top. Skin looks lit, not flat. Build it up for full coverage or keep it sheer — either way, it lasts.

title: Medium 90 W
body_html: Medium 90 W leans into honey warmth, built for medium skin with a golden cast. It blends like a dream, melting shadows and blemishes into a glow instead of a mask. Buildable coverage means you control how much shows through, and it holds steady without creasing past noon.

title: Medium 85 N
body_html: Right in the middle, no bias either way — Medium 85 N is the neutral pick for medium skin tones. A few taps melt in fast, blurring uneven patches and dark circles into a soft-focus finish. It wears comfortably from your first meeting to your last errand, no touch-ups needed.

title: Medium 83 C
body_html: Medium 83 C brings the pink back for cooler medium skin. It taps on cool and true, covering blemishes and shadow without drifting warm or muddy. The texture stays cushiony on skin, building coverage in layers instead of sitting heavy. Blend it out and let your skin breathe.

title: Light 60 N
body_html: No undertone drama here. Light 60 N sits at true neutral, matching skin that doesn't lean warm or cool. It melts in on contact, buffs out dark circles and redness, and settles into a soft matte-adjacent finish that won't crease by lunch. Simple shade, simple win.

title: Light 50 W
body_html: Light 50 W runs warm, built for skin that leans golden past the fairest shades. It presses into skin like a second layer, blurring blemishes and morning puffiness while keeping that lit-from-within warmth intact. No flashback, no cakiness, just a smoothed-out finish that holds through happy hour.

title: Light 45 W
body_html: Light 45 W brings warmth to the light range, built for skin with a golden undertone that fairer, cooler shades can't match. It melts in fast and builds from medium to full coverage, blurring imperfections into a smooth, natural finish that stays put without settling.

title: Light 40 N
body_html: Light 40 N moves into the light range at true neutral, matching skin that's grown past the fairest shades. The formula melts into skin on contact, building medium-to-full coverage that blurs blemishes and shadows while resisting creasing in fine lines all day long.

title: Light 33 C
body_html: Porcelain with a pink flush — that's Light 33 C. Built for cooler, fair-to-light skin, it melts on with zero drag and blurs shadows without leaning orange or ashy. Coverage builds from a light tap to full glam in seconds, then locks in without creasing into laugh lines. Blend and go.

title: Fair 20 N
body_html: A shade past Fair 10 N, Fair 20 N keeps the same neutral balance with a bit more depth for skin that needs it. This concealer's melt-in texture builds seamlessly from a light tap to full coverage, blurring imperfections without ever looking dry or cakey under the eyes.

title: Fair 15 W
body_html: One shade past Fair 05 W, same golden warmth, a little more oomph. Fair 15 W blends in with a fingertip and blurs under-eye puffiness, blemish marks, and that 3pm shine without settling into fine lines. It stays soft and second-skin all day. Pat it on and forget about it.

title: Fair 10 N
body_html: Fair 10 N sits at true neutral in the fairest part of the range — no warm or cool cast to fight against. The creamy formula melts in fast, building medium-to-full coverage that blurs dark circles and blemishes while staying put through a full day without settling into creases.

title: Fair 05 W
body_html: Barely there, big payoff. Fair 05 W is our lightest warm shade, made for the fairest skin with a golden undertone. It taps on sheer, then builds fast over dark circles and morning-after redness without turning cakey or gray. Skin looks like skin, just calmer. Swipe it on before your coffee's even done.

title: Dark 20 N
body_html: Dark 20 N closes out the dark range at its deepest, richest point — a true neutral umber with zero gray or ashy cast. The lightweight tint melts in sheer, then builds to real coverage without ever feeling heavy. Hyaluronic acid keeps skin dewy and comfortable well into the day.

title: Dark 18 W
body_html: Dark 18 W brings warmth into the dark range with a golden chestnut cast, just a touch richer than its neutral neighbor. The tint melts on contact and blurs imperfections without masking real skin texture. Hyaluronic acid keeps the dewy finish comfortable from morning through night.

title: Medium Dark 16 N
body_html: Medium Dark 16 N closes the medium-dark family at true neutral — a balanced terracotta depth without gold or pink pulling it one way. title: Medium Dark 15 W

title: Medium Dark 13 W
body_html: Medium Dark 13 W opens the richer half of the range with a warm, amber-toned depth. The tint's water-based base blurs into skin on contact, sheer at first and buildable to more coverage without ever feeling thick. Hyaluronic acid keeps the dewy finish going well past application.

title: Medium 12 W

Sheer color melts into skin fast, letting hyaluronic acid keep things plump and dewy underneath. Build it up in thin layers for a natural, sun-kissed finish.

title: Medium 11 N

The water-based tint blurs into skin sheer and buildable, while hyaluronic acid keeps the finish dewy instead of dry. Perfect for skin that runs a shade warmer than expected.

title: Medium 10 N
body_html: Medium 10 N steps into medium depth at a neutral cast, for skin that's outgrown the light shades. The hyaluronic acid formula keeps its dewy, skin-like finish even as it builds, blurring imperfections into a fresh wash of color rather than hiding them under weight.

title: Light 7 W

title: Fair 2 W

title: Ritz
body_html: Dressed to impress — this warm champagne-gold Ultra-Glitter brings the glam from boardroom to bar cart, effortlessly. Its crème-to-powder base sweeps on in one glide and dries down bouncy-soft, holding supercharged sparkle through last call with barely a hint of creasing or fallout.

title: Party of Five
body_html: The more the merrier — this dusty rose Ultra-Glitter lands in a gorgeous rosy mauve packed with silver sparkle, beautiful solo or stacked. One pass of this crème-to-powder formula sets into a soft, bouncy cushion of pigment that clings tight with minimal creasing or fade.

title: Banana
body_html:
Brightening. Blurring. Iconic. Banana's warm yellow tone color-corrects, brightens, and sets your look for a radiant, soft-focus finish that photographs beautifully in any light. Our No Filter Loose Setting Powder is made with ultra-fine smooth powders that deliver a long-lasting matte finish — never heavy, never cakey, never flashback. 100% vegan and cruelty-free, and photo-tested to keep you selfie-ready in any light.

Net Weight 8.5g (0.30oz)

title: Ladybird
body_html: Delicate, sparkling, and completely luminous — this pale pearl champagne shade is packed with silver Ultra-Glitter for an effortlessly glowing eye look. One gentle swipe of this crème-to-powder formula settles into a bouncy, creamy finish that keeps sparkle locked on with barely any creasing, fading or fallout.

title: Small Detail Brush

title: Frog

Swiped on in one motion, the crème-to-powder formula melts into a bouncy, creamy base that locks pigment in place with next to no creasing, fading or fallout.

title: DGAF
body_html: Zero rules, all the vibes — this warm rusty brown Ultra-Glitter is loaded with multi-dimensional gold for a look that refuses to be basic. This shadow doesn't ask permission — the crème-to-powder formula sets fast, holds its bouncy, richly pigmented colour, and refuses to crease, fade, or fall out no matter how long the day runs.

title: Small Pencil Brush
body_html: Smaller and more precise than the Pencil Brush, this one covers all the details. Great for smoking out eyeliner or shadow across the lashline.

title: Small Tapered Brush
body_html: The smaller sister of the Tapered Blending Brush, this one is perfect for more precise blending and defining the crease.

title: Sailor
body_html: Set sail on your best neutral yet — this warm beige-tan metallic catches the light with a soft, sun-warmed glow that grounds any look instantly. Press once. Set fast. Stay put. This crème-to-powder formula is bouncy and creamy on contact, delivers full colour immediately, and won't crease, fade, or fall out all day.

title: Angled Eye Brush
body_html: Precision eye lining and brow shaping. The firm, angled brush can be used with powder or cream formulas. Clean cat eyes and feathery brows are in your future.

title: Tapered Blending Brush
body_html: Blend, blend, blend that shadow with our super soft, tapered blending brush. Perfect to use with powder or cream formulas, it fits perfectly in the crease to blend and diffuse any eyeshadow.

title: Blending Brush
body_html: Buff it out! For eyeshadows and even concealers, this small fluffy brush applies and blends out cream or powder formulas easily.

title: Small Shader Brush
body_html: Apply eyeshadow or concealer exactly where you want it. The flat, firm tip provides precise application for powder, cream, or liquid formulas.

title: Small Fluff Brush
body_html: It’s small, fluffy, and super versatile. Use it to highlight, shade, or set your under eyes with cream or powder formulas. This little guy does it all!

title: Fan Brush
body_html: Make your highlight pop! The fan shape provides a super soft application, perfect for powder, cream or liquid highlighters.

title: Blush Brush
body_html: The brush that does it all - blush, bronzer, highlighter, you name it, it can blend it! Use it for cream or powder formulas, this one is a must have.

title: Large Powder Brush
body_html: For the perfect dusting of face powder or bronzer on the face or body, use our large, full and fluffy face brush.

title: Moonwalk
body_html: One small swipe, one giant glam move — this deep antique gold Duochrome shifts to olive-green in every light for a look that's truly out of this world.
